# Aditya Singhal: assistant and developer resources

> Connect to Adi's Ambipath website assistant, or read public profile, project, writing and workshop information.

## Website assistant

- [Canonical PAP discovery](https://assistant-5fb03649c9914801a952129b908a3ac9.agents.ambipath.com/.well-known/poppy.json): start here for a conversation with the website assistant.
- [MCP transport](https://assistant-5fb03649c9914801a952129b908a3ac9.agents.ambipath.com/mcp): requires a signed PAP session and a compatible client.
- [Conversations endpoint](https://assistant-5fb03649c9914801a952129b908a3ac9.agents.ambipath.com/conversations): requires a signed PAP session.
- [Access details](https://adityasinghal.com/auth.md): assistant authentication and separate public data access.

Discovery is public. Conversation and MCP access require PAP authentication and session handling; not every agent client supports them. Use [the homepage assistant](https://adityasinghal.com/) if your client cannot connect.

## Public data

Use these resources to integrate the public information into a directory, learning assistant or profile summary. No account or API key is needed.

- [Developer guide](https://adityasinghal.com/developers.md): examples, response handling and version policy.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://adityasinghal.com/openapi.json): exact GET operations and response schemas.
- [API index](https://adityasinghal.com/api/v1/index.json): the four available data documents.
- [Agent instructions](https://adityasinghal.com/agents.md): source selection and citation guidance.
- [Access policy](https://adityasinghal.com/auth.md): assistant session requirements, unauthenticated public data and errors.
- [Root reading map](https://adityasinghal.com/llms.txt): profile, projects, writing and teaching.
